d: A nail is a thin, sharp piece of metal that you hit with a hammer to join wood together.
If someone is naked, they are completely bare and not wearing any clothes at all.
Your name is the word that people use to call you or identify you.
A nap is a short sleep that you take during the day to feel rested.
A napkin is a square piece of cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating.
If something is narrow, it is very thin and measures a small distance from one side to the other.
If something is nasty, it is extremely unpleasant, bad, or mean.
A nation is a large country with its own land, language, and independent government.
National means relating to the whole of a country rather than just one specific part of it.
Your nationality is the official status of belonging to a particular country.
Your native language or country is the one you were born into and grew up with.
If something is natural, it exists in nature and was not created by humans.
You use naturally to say that something happens in a normal, expected way without extra help.
Nature consists of all the animals, plants, and natural environments in the world.
Naval means relating to a country's navy and its military ships at sea.
If you navigate, you find the right direction to steer a ship, car, or airplane.
The navy is the part of a country's military forces that fights at sea using ships.
If something is near a place, it is located only a very short distance away from it.
If a place is nearby, it is very close to where you are right now.
You use nearly to say that something is almost true or almost completely finished.
If a room or person is neat, they are very tidy, clean, and well-organized.
You use necessarily to say that something is a guaranteed or unavoidable result.
If something is necessary, you absolutely must have it or do it.
Your neck is the part of your body that connects your head to your shoulders.
A necklace is a piece of jewelry that women wear around their necks.
If you need something, you must have it because it is essential for you.
A needle is a very thin, sharp piece of metal used for sewing clothes.
If a situation is negative, it is bad, harmful, or lacks any hope.
If you neglect something, you fail to take care of it properly.
If you negotiate, you discuss a deal with someone to try and reach a fair agreement.
A negotiation is a formal discussion between people trying to reach a business agreement.
A neighbor is a person who lives in the house right next to yours.
A neighborhood is the specific local area of a town where people live.
You use neither to show that two negative statements are both true.
Your nephew is the son of your brother or your sister.
A nerve is a thin thread in your body that carries messages to and from your brain.
If you are nervous, you feel worried and slightly afraid about what might happen.
A nest is a home built by birds out of sticks to lay their eggs safely in.
A net is a material made of crossed threads with holes, used for catching fish or playing sports.
A network is a large system of connected computers, roads, or people.
If someone is neutral, they refuse to take sides in an argument or war.
If something never happens, it does not happen at any time at all.
You use nevertheless to introduce a surprising fact that contrasts with what was just said.
If something is new, it has recently been made, bought, or discovered.
If something has newly happened, it happened only a very short time ago.
A newlywed is a person who has very recently gotten married.
The news is information about recent important events reported on television or in papers.
A newspaper is a large set of folded printed sheets containing daily news and articles.
The next thing is the one that immediately follows the present one in time or order.
If someone is nice, they are kind, pleasant, and friendly to be around.
If something is done nicely, it is done in a very attractive or pleasant way.
Your niece is the daughter of your brother or your sister.
Night is the dark part of every 24-hour period when the sun is not in the sky.
A nightmare is a very frightening and terrifying dream.
Nine is the number between eight and ten.
Nineteen is the number between eighteen and twenty.
Ninety is the number between eighty-nine and ninety-one.
Nobody means no person at all.
When you nod, you move your head up and down to show agreement or to say yes.
A noise is a loud, harsh, or unpleasant sound.
If a place is noisy, it is full of loud and annoying sounds.
If you nominate someone, you officially suggest that they should get a job or prize.
A nominee is a person who has been officially chosen to compete for an award or job.
None means not even one person or thing out of a whole group.
You use nonetheless to state that something is still true despite the previous facts.
Nonsense is spoken or written words that mean absolutely nothing or are foolish.
Noon is twelve o'clock in the middle of the daytime.
You use nor to add another negative statement to one you have just made.
If a situation is normal, it is usual, expected, and exactly as it should be.
If something happens normally, it happens in the usual or most common way.
North is the direction that is straight up on most maps.
Northern means located in or coming from the part of a country that faces north.
Your nose is the part of your face that you use for breathing and smelling.
You use not to make a word or statement entirely negative.
A note is a short piece of writing to remind you of something or inform someone.
A notebook is a small book with blank pages for writing down information.
Nothing means not a single thing or completely zero.
If you notice something, you see it, hear it, or become completely aware of it.
If something is noticeable, it is very easy to see and clearly stands out.
A notion is a belief or a specific idea that someone has in their mind.
A noun is a grammar word that represents a person, place, or thing.
A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.
A novelist is a professional writer who writes long fictional books.
November is the eleventh month of the year in the modern calendar.
You use now to mean at this exact present moment in time.
You use nowadays to talk about the present time compared to how things were in the past.
Nowhere means not in any place or not at any location at all.
Nuclear energy is powerful energy created by splitting atoms in a special reactor.
A number is a word or symbol like 1, 2, or 3 used in mathematics.
If things are numerous, there are a very large number of them.
A nurse is a trained medical worker who cares for sick people in a hospital.
A nursery is a place where very young children are taken care of while their parents work.
A nut is a dry fruit with a very hard shell and an edible center.
A nutrient is a chemical in food that plants and animals need to live and grow.
Nutrition is the process of eating the right healthy foods to help your body grow.
Nylon is a strong artificial material used to make clothes and thick ropes.
A niche is a specific, specialized market or position that perfectly suits someone.
If someone is naive, they easily trust people because they lack real-world experience.
A nuance is a very small, subtle difference in meaning, color, or sound.
Nougat is a chewy, sweet candy made from sugar, honey, and roasted nuts.
